scope: C-008 unique GenerationIntent, short TX-02/TX-03 publication, PublishGuard, start/status/today API, outbox/inbox recovery and guarded Redis projection cache

assertions: claim and publish decisions reject stale revision, changed guard, closed completion window and terminal state
existing published facts return the existing result instead of creating another publication
strict start input rejects owner, product date, result version, root seed and guard epoch fields
OpenAPI start/status/today paths bind the shared request and client-view contracts
pending, retryable and terminal generation outcomes remain stable typed API errors
double start and same-command replay return one intent while changed payload conflicts
status and today use owner-scoped resources and expose bounded Retry-After polling
Today returns only the allowlisted content, interaction and relationship projection
Safety blocks start, status and Today before ordinary views are exposed
all three routes use stable low-cardinality operation codes
Inbox transaction claims one intent before post-commit deterministic execution
duplicate post-commit recovery safely executes the same intent again
stale or unknown guard epochs cancel or terminally reject before generation

T-C008-DB-001.selector: C-008 real PostgreSQL idempotent generation, publication and guard fences
assertions: two starts create one owner/date intent, snapshot and accepted outbox event
two concurrent publishers leave one immutable result and the loser returns existing
Safety and DAY deletion arriving before publish cancel the intent and create no result
deterministic failure becomes terminal and Today exposes only the stable terminal outcome
non-owner reads are not found and API/Interactive roles keep their reviewed ACL boundaries
cache-miss Today rebuilds the client projection from the authoritative PostgreSQL AVAILABLE result

T-C008-QUEUE-001.selector: C-008 outbox/inbox publishes once and Redis cache loss rebuilds from PostgreSQL
assertions: real PostgreSQL outbox relays through Redis 8 and BullMQ 5 into the Interactive Inbox handler
commit-before-ACK retry reuses one InboxReceipt and one published result
Redis FLUSHALL loses no business fact and Today rebuilds the same projection from PostgreSQL
a live DAY deletion guard blocks a previously cached Today projection

T-C008-DEPLOY-001.selector: T-COMPOSE-STATIC-001 accepts the bounded E-009 topology
assertions: API Redis access is limited to the internal api_data network
Redis configuration participates in the API deploy fingerprint without becoming a startup truth dependency
